344002.reason: The counterexample to Graham's conjecture (arXiv:1910.00924, all extreme n-subsets of Z_p equivalent) uses supports of circulant weighing matrices CW(71,25); CW => extreme is a one-line Fourier identity (|mu-hat| = 5 everywhere), and inequivalent CW(71,25) belong to the classical CW literature (Strassler's 1997 table, n <= 200, s <= 10, reported by the lane as four inequivalent CW(71,25); Gordon's La Jolla CW database, root fetch cw-root-check/cwm.html). The remaining step, affine inequivalence of supports, is a routine finite check. Routine bridge from published constructions (355525 principle). Strassler's printed rows were not read (ScienceDirect).
